# Skill Launcher Cloud - agent guide

A static page with no server: it edits the private GitHub repo Zoobot123/manga-skills through the GitHub API, with a token
kept in the user's browser. An agent does not click this page. Use the repo directly (git or the gh CLI).

## Quick start
```
gh api repos/Zoobot123/manga-skills/git/trees/main?recursive=1
gh api repos/Zoobot123/manga-skills/contents/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md
```

## Layout
- skills/<name>/    skills Claude Code loads on the PC.
- library/<name>/   stored skills, never loaded.
- <name>/launcher.json   the skill's form: jobs, fields, prompt tail.
- .skill-launcher/families.json   the user's category choices {skill: family}.
- .skill-launcher/stock.json      dropdown lists, written by the PC sync.
- .skill-launcher/pending.json    [{op: trash|move, skill, to}] done in the cloud. The next PC sync applies and clears them.

## Rules
- Trigger phrases live in the SKILL.md description: "Trigger on 'a', 'b'. Not for: c."
- Moving or removing a skill in the repo must also add a pending.json entry, or the PC sync puts it back.
- Removing a skill needs the user's yes. Never commit a key or token. Every cast field says "Name, 18+ version".
- With the PC on, use Skill Launcher instead: http://127.0.0.1:4340/llms.txt
